name: Isle of Man
facts: King Charles III, as Lord of Mann

flag.description: A red field with a triskelion in the centre: three armoured legs with gold spurs, joined at the thigh and running clockwise.
flag.symbolism: The three legs have been the island's emblem since the Middle Ages and are linked to its motto, "Whithersoever you throw it, it will stand".

hook: The Isle of Man flag is all legs: three armoured legs spinning on a plain red field, with no cross or stripe anywhere.
trivia: Sicily's flag also bears a three-legged triskelion, but with a Gorgon's head at the centre.
Tynwald, the Manx parliament, claims to be the oldest parliament in the world with an unbroken history.
